text: Without solving, find whether the pair 3x − 5y = 20 and 6x − 10y = 40 is consistent. If it is, state the number of solutions and how the two lines look on a graph.
Draw up a table of values for the lines x + y = 6 and x − y = 2. From the graphs, find their point of intersection and the area of the triangle formed by the two lines and the x-axis.
Solve by elimination: 3x + 4y = 10 and x − y = 1. Verify your answer.
A two-digit number is 4 times the sum of its digits. If 18 is added to the number, the digits get reversed. Find the number.

The numerator and denominator of a fraction are x and y. If 1 is added to the numerator and 3 to the denominator, the fraction becomes 2/5. If 1 is subtracted from both numerator and denominator, it becomes 1/3. Find the fraction.
Five years ago a father was 7 times as old as his son. Five years from now he will be 3 times as old as his son. Find their present ages.
The pair of equations 2x + 3y = 7 and (2a − b)x + (a + b)y = 4a + b − 3 has infinitely many solutions. Find the values of a and b.
The lines 2x + 3y = 12 and x − y = 1 are drawn on the same graph. Find the point where they intersect, and the area of the triangle formed by these two lines and the y-axis.
Solve graphically the pair x + 2y = 8 and 3x − 2y = 0. Also find the area of the triangle formed by the two lines and the x-axis.

A man travels 360 km, partly by bus and partly by train. If he travels 120 km by bus and the rest by train, the journey takes 5 hours. If he travels 200 km by bus and the rest by train, it takes 5 hours 20 minutes. Find the speed of the bus and of the train.
A boat takes 8 hours to go 18 km upstream and 50 km downstream. It takes 7 hours to go 30 km upstream and 20 km downstream. Find the speed of the boat in still water and the speed of the stream.

At a village fair, entry tickets are sold at one price for adults and another for children. On Saturday, 2 adults and 3 children together paid ₹600. On Sunday, a group of 4 adults and 1 child paid ₹700. Let an adult ticket cost ₹a and a child ticket cost ₹c.
(i) Write the two linear equations that represent this situation. [1]
(ii) Find the cost of one child ticket. [1]
(iii) Find the cost of one adult ticket, and the total amount paid by a family of 2 adults and 5 children. [2]

A taxi company charges a fixed amount (₹f) plus a fixed rate per kilometre (₹r). Rohan paid ₹175 for a 10 km ride and Seema paid ₹287 for an 18 km ride.
(i) Write two linear equations in f and r for this information. [1]
(ii) Find the rate per kilometre. [1]
(iii) Find the fixed charge and the fare for a 25 km ride. [2]
OR
(iii) Find the fixed charge and the distance travelled by a passenger who paid ₹497. [2]
